patch_description: Introduce a horizontal-vs-vertical split for edge-related parameters in the hybrid ansatz. This preserves the overall structure but increases expressivity by distinguishing correlations along the two edge directions (top-middle/bottom-middle vs left-middle/right-middle). It adds three new parameter keys per block (rz_pre_edge_h, rz_pre_edge_v; ry_edge_h, ry_edge_v; rz_post_edge_h, rz_post_edge_v) while reusing the existing hub-ring CRZ and ring-CRX structure. This targeted change leverages board symmetry with a modest parameter budget (+3 keys per block, increasing total params from 11 to 14 per block). The expected effect is improved validation/test performance due to richer, yet structured, correlations.

    """Build hybrid ansatz combining parametrized ring (CRX) and shared hub (CRZ).

    Structure:
    1. Pre-entanglement RZ on corners/edges/center (shared per group)
    2. RY rotations on corners/edges/center (shared per group)
    3. Ring entanglement: parametrized CRX gates with shared parameter
    4. Hub entanglement: CRZ gates from center to edges with shared parameter
    5. Post-entanglement RZ on corners/edges/center (shared per group)

    - Parametrized ring from program 2 (improved validation accuracy to 0.65)
    - Shared hub parameter from program 1 (reduced parameter count)

    # Layer 4: Hub entanglement (center to edges) with shared parameter

    spec.append({"gate": "RZ", "wire": 7, "param": "rz_post_edge"})
    spec.append({"gate": "RZ", "wire": 8, "param": "rz_post_center"})

    return spec
